required_user_actions: Open Mesh and create an enrollment request for Rend.
Copy the complete agent-facing enrollment instruction containing PTM1.
Send that instruction to Rend through the existing Telegram conversation.
Respond through Telegram only if Rend's normal security policy explicitly requests owner approval.
forbidden_user_actions: RDP or remote desktop into Rend
manually copy a Mesh archive to Rend
manually install or enable the Mesh plugin
pass_conditions: Rend understands the PTM1-directed enrollment as an owner instruction.
Rend discovers the universal enrollment protocol and OpenClaw adapter.
Rend downloads and verifies the pinned package himself.
Rend waits for an idle/safe point before managed plugin installation if runtime reload is required.
The plugin automatically redeems the pending enrollment after installation.
A local reconnect credential is persisted.
Telegram-originated activity is observable in Mesh.
Mesh conversation remains independent from Telegram conversation state.
Refreshing or disconnecting Mesh does not interrupt Rend's Telegram work.
claims_not_yet_proven_until_live_test: Rend can perform the complete self-bootstrap with current real permissions.
OpenClaw passive hooks expose all desired activity without side effects.
Mesh conversation isolation is correct under sequential live usage.
OpenClaw managed installation can complete on Rend without a workstation-side approval path.
